description: Defines internal structures, classes, and functions for audio sink management in the Starboard platform, including creation, validation, and lifecycle handling of audio sink objects.

classes.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::Type
classes.description: Abstract class defining interface for creating, validating, and destroying audio sink objects.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::Type::Create
methods.description: Creates an audio sink with specified parameters.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::Type::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a given audio sink is valid.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the audio sink.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the audio sink.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::IsType
methods.description: Checks if the current sink matches a given type.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::TearDown
methods.description: Tears down the audio sink subsystem.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::SetPrimaryType
methods.description: Sets the primary audio sink type.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::GetPrimaryType
methods.description: Retrieves the primary audio sink type.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::EnableFallbackToStub
methods.description: Enables fallback to stub audio sink type.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::GetFallbackType
methods.description: Retrieves the fallback audio sink type if enabled.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::GetPreferredType
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred audio sink type, primary if available, otherwise fallback.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::Create
methods.description: Creates an audio sink with specified parameters, using primary or fallback type.
